name: vote-tally
title: Vote Tally
blurb: Voting widget where users upvote items to show preference or demand.
description: Tracks vote counts and which items the user has voted for. Supports controlled and uncontrolled modes. Items can be disabled globally or individually. Context-driven sub-components render count, title, and description.
use_when: Feature requests, community polls, or priority voting on multi-item lists.
avoid_when: Downvoting or rated (5-star) systems; this is upvote-only.
a11y: Root is a ul; items are li. Trigger buttons and text elements have no aria labels; depends on container text for context.
